text.en:
Weapon Kills while within 15 meters of enemies grant a stack of Proximity Power 10 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Each stack grants #e${15+#d} Melee stat.

enhanced (
var d = 3
#e Grants 3 more Melee stat per stack.
)
